013169** A2K-ACCEPT-TODAYS-DATE.                                     ** 000700      
013170** This Paragraph accepts the TODAYS-DATE from System in Long  ** 000800      
013171** Format e.g. MM/DD/CCAA. And it converts into a numeric      ** 000900      
013172** date MMDDCCAA, which is returned into the variable          ** 001000      
013173** A2K-FEC-MDCA-001.                                           ** 001100      
013174***************************************************************** 001200      
013175                                                                  001300      
013176 A2K-ACCEPT-TODAYS-DATE.                                          001400      
013177        MOVE ZEROES TO A2K-FEC-MDCA-001.                          001500      
013178*       MOVE "    " TO A2K-SYSTEM-FECHA.                          001600      
013179        ACCEPT A2K-SYSTEM-FECHA FROM TODAYS-DATE.                 001700      
013180        MOVE A2K-SYSTEM-FECHA-MM TO A2K-FEC-MDCA-MM-001.          001800      
013181        MOVE A2K-SYSTEM-FECHA-DD TO A2K-FEC-MDCA-DD-001.          001900      
013182        MOVE A2K-SYSTEM-FECHA-CC TO A2K-FEC-MDCA-CC-001.          002000      
013183        MOVE A2K-SYSTEM-FECHA-AA TO A2K-FEC-MDCA-AA-001.          002100      
013184                                                                  002200
